us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Seattle food festival shooting involved at least three suspects, police say
bullets: Three people were killed and four others injured at the Bite of Seattle festival.
Court documents said police believe at least three shooters were involved.
A 15-year-old was arrested while another suspect remained unidentified.

articles.title: Northeastern Wisconsin tornado causes major damage and widespread outages
bullets: A confirmed tornado struck Winnebago County and nearby Fox Cities communities.
More than 30,000 customers lost power after homes and businesses were damaged.
Officials reported no confirmed fatalities by Monday evening, but searches continued.

articles.title: Trump administration asks Supreme Court to revive mail-voting restrictions
bullets: The administration filed an emergency appeal over Trump’s voting executive order.
Lower courts blocked limits tied to a proposed federal eligible-voter list.
The order is contested by 23 states ahead of the November midterms.

articles.title: Trump touts auto tariffs during Michigan economy speech
bullets: Trump praised a 25% tariff on foreign cars at a GM facility in Milford, Michigan.
He said the tariffs protected U.S. auto jobs and revived domestic production.
The speech came as tariff policy remained central to his economic message.

articles.title: Pentagon casualty count no longer lists four Iran-war deaths in official tally
bullets: Four U.S. troops killed in recent Iran-related fighting were moved to a separate category.
The change raised questions about how the Pentagon is counting war casualties.
A new “Overseas Operations” category listed the four Army deaths and 207 wounded.

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Top worldwide stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Magnitude 7.1 earthquake hits southern Japan; people trapped at mall
bullets: A 7.1 magnitude quake struck Kumamoto on Japan’s Kyushu island.
Officials reported injuries and damage, with no tsunami detected in AP’s update.
A shopping mall floor collapsed after a reported explosion, trapping people.

articles.title: France and Spain battle historic wildfires amid renewed heat
bullets: France ordered nearly 4,000 more evacuations from Atlantic coast tourist areas.
A fire west of Madrid became Spain’s largest on record, burning over 500 square kilometers.
Western Europe’s record June heat and dryness worsened wildfire conditions.

articles.title: Mediators report progress toward restarting U.S.–Iran talks
bullets: Regional officials said mediators made progress getting Washington and Tehran back to negotiations.
The push followed a pause in attacks after a rapid escalation in the Iran war.
Drone attacks and shipping tensions continued to rattle the region.

articles.title: Iran hangs two men convicted over January protest violence
bullets: Iran executed two men convicted of killing four police officers during January protests.
State media reported the hangings on Tuesday.
The case is tied to Iran’s wider crackdown after nationwide unrest.

articles.title: Netanyahu to meet Trump as Iran-war diplomacy intensifies
bullets: AP reported Netanyahu would meet Trump for the first time since the Iran war began.
The agenda included Iran, Lebanon, Hezbollah and the Abraham Accords.
The meeting comes as Trump continues pressing Iran to make a deal.

india.label: India News
india.subtitle: Top India stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Government and Opposition clash over anti-paper leak Bill in Lok Sabha
bullets: The Lok Sabha debated the Public Examinations Amendment Bill, 2026.
The government said the bill would strengthen penalties and fast-track trials.
Opposition MPs demanded answers on police action against student protesters.

articles.title: Rajya Sabha adjourned again amid NEET uproar
bullets: Rajya Sabha proceedings were adjourned for the seventh straight day.
Opposition parties protested alleged police action against NEET paper-leak demonstrators.
The MSME Development Amendment Bill was introduced amid the din.

articles.title: Bihar constable suspended after firing AK-47 during protest
bullets: Bihar Police suspended Siwan constable Abhishek Kumar.
A video showed him firing four rounds in the air during a July 25 protest.
Police rules restrict AK-47 use in general law-and-order duties.

articles.title: Crater appears near ₹16-crore Dehradun bridge 16 days after opening
bullets: Part of the approach road to a new Dehradun bridge caved in on Tuesday.
Officials blamed heavy rain washing soil from beneath the approach road.
The contractor was directed to repair the damage under the defect-liability period.

articles.title: Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport set for August 1 inauguration
bullets: Prime Minister Modi is scheduled to inaugurate the Bhogapuram airport on August 1.
The ₹4,727-crore greenfield airport is near Visakhapatnam in Andhra Pradesh.
Its first phase is designed to handle 6 million passengers annually.

articles.title: Nvidia falls as AI financing worries hit chip stocks
bullets: Nvidia shares fell about 5% in Monday trading.
Reuters-linked reports tied the move to concerns over AI infrastructure financing exposure.
The drop weighed on the Nasdaq and broader semiconductor sentiment.

articles.title: Micron slides as AI-chip anxiety spreads
bullets: Micron fell 2.3% in Monday’s session, according to AP’s market report.
Reuters also reported Micron was down 4.6% in Tuesday premarket trading.
Investors sold chip names on China competition and AI-spending concerns.

articles.title: Applied Materials drops in premarket after China DUV report
bullets: Applied Materials lost 3.5% in Tuesday premarket trading, Reuters reported.
The move followed reports that China began producing homegrown DUV lithography tools.
Chip-equipment stocks faced pressure from fears of rising Chinese competition.

articles.title: Apple gains as investors rotate within megacap tech
bullets: Apple rose 1.2% in Monday trading, AP reported.
The move contrasted with weakness in Nvidia and Micron.
Investors were positioning ahead of several megacap technology earnings reports.

articles.title: Microsoft rises ahead of earnings-heavy week
bullets: Microsoft gained 1.9% Monday, according to AP’s market report.
Reuters said Microsoft was among the major tech companies set to report this week.
Investors focused on guidance and AI-related capital spending plans.

articles.title: Wall Street ends mixed as investors brace for Fed and megacap earnings
bullets: U.S. stocks ended mixed Monday after an early rally faded.
Investors awaited Microsoft, Amazon, Meta and Apple earnings.
Markets also watched whether oil-driven inflation could push the Fed toward higher rates.

articles.title: Oil drops as U.S.–Iran pause eases immediate supply fears
bullets: Crude prices fell after the U.S. and Iran paused attacks.
Brent retreated from last week’s spike above $100 a barrel.
Markets viewed the pause as a possible opening for diplomacy around the Strait of Hormuz.

articles.title: CXMT surges in Shanghai debut, becoming China’s most valuable listed company
bullets: Chinese memory chipmaker CXMT soared in its Shanghai market debut.
AP reported its market capitalization reached about 3.3 trillion yuan, nearly $490 billion.
The debut sharpened investor focus on Chinese semiconductor competition.

articles.title: Air India starts inbound hub-and-spoke operations at Amritsar airport
bullets: Air India said it would implement inbound hub-and-spoke SOP operations at Amritsar.
The facility was inaugurated at Sri Guru Ram Das Ji International Airport.
PTI images showed civil aviation officials attending the event.

articles.title: U.S. stocks face tests from Fed decision and tech-led earnings wave
bullets: Reuters said markets were entering a packed week of Fed and earnings catalysts.
Alphabet and Tesla declines had already pressured indexes the previous week.
Investors were watching whether AI-heavy spending is supported by profit growth.

articles.title: Moonshot AI releases Kimi K3 model weights
bullets: Moonshot AI released Kimi K3 weights and a technical report.
The model is described as a major open-weight release from China’s AI sector.
Reports said the release intensified scrutiny of U.S.–China AI competition.

articles.title: China begins making homegrown DUV chipmaking tools, report says
bullets: Reuters cited The Information saying China has begun producing immersion DUV lithography machines.
The tools are key to semiconductor manufacturing and have long been dominated by ASML.
The report pressured global chip-equipment and semiconductor shares.

articles.title: AI anxiety sparks broad tech selloff across Asia
bullets: Reuters reported chip stocks fell sharply across Asia on Tuesday.
South Korea’s KOSPI dropped nearly 10% and triggered a circuit breaker.
Investors cited Chinese competition and concerns over AI infrastructure financing.

articles.title: Nasdaq futures fall as AI-chip worries hit U.S. names
bullets: Reuters reported Nasdaq futures fell Tuesday ahead of major tech earnings.
Nvidia, Micron and Applied Materials declined in premarket trading.
U.S.-listed TSMC and SK Hynix shares also fell.

articles.title: Nvidia’s Jensen Huang defends Chinese AI models after Kimi reaction
bullets: Axios reported Huang praised Chinese AI models including Kimi K3.
He argued that strong open models should not be dismissed over security concerns alone.
The comments came after Kimi K3 triggered fresh U.S. industry debate.
